info.title: SugarCrumbs API
info.description: The bakery's storefront (`/api/public/**`, no token) and the Owner's dashboard (everything else, bearer access token from `POST /api/auth/login`). Every error has the `ApiError` body.

400.description: Invalid input: validation (`fieldErrors` lists the fields), a malformed value, or a business rule

401.description: No valid access token, or bad credentials

409.description: Conflicts with the current state (e.g. slot full, sold out, a duplicate name), or another request changed the same data first; reload and retry
